description: This is a test source file for the ImmutableJsonObject class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It contains unit tests validating the behavior, immutability, equality, property access, manipulation, and traversal of JSON objects represented by ImmutableJsonObject.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectTest
classes.description: A comprehensive set of unit tests validating the behavior, immutability, equality, property access, and mutation of ImmutableJsonObject instances.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Validates that ImmutableJsonObject and its internal structures are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode are implemented correctly, including with prefab values.

methods.name: orderOfFieldsDoesNotAffectEquality
methods.description: Checks that ordering of fields does not influence equality comparison.

methods.name: twoParsedObjectsFromSameStringHaveSameHashCode
methods.description: Ensures that parsing the same JSON string produces objects with identical hash codes.

methods.name: getInstanceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the static 'empty' instance is consistent.

methods.name: objectIsNothingElse
methods.description: Verifies that the empty JsonValue behaves as an object but with no content.

methods.name: checkUnsupportedOperations
methods.description: Asserts that certain unsupported operations throw expected exceptions.

methods.name: getInstanceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the created JsonObject of known fields matches expected string representation.

methods.name: getReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that retrieving a value by key returns the expected value.

methods.name: setWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies setting a value returns a new JsonObject with the added key-value pair.

methods.name: tryToSetIntValueWithNullKey
methods.description: Confirms that setting a value with a null key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetIntValueWithEmptyKey
methods.description: Ensures that setting a value with an empty key throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setIntCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Test that setting an int creates a new object that is disjoint from the original.

methods.name: setExistingIntReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks that setting an existing key to the same value returns the same instance.

methods.name: setIntWithKeyContainingSlashes
methods.description: Verifies that keys with slashes are correctly interpreted.

methods.name: setFieldTwiceReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that updating a field with the same value returns the same object instance.

methods.name: setLongCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Tests setting a long value creates a new disjoint object.

methods.name: setDoubleCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Tests setting a double value creates a new disjoint object.

methods.name: setBooleanCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Tests setting a boolean value creates a new disjoint object.

methods.name: setStringCreatesDisjoint
methods.description: Tests setting a string value results in a disjoint object.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Confirms that setting a value with a null JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithEmptyJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that setting a value with an empty JsonPointer throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithSlashCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that setting a value with a slash string as key produces an object with that key.

methods.name: setValueWithSlashJsonKeyWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies setting a value with a JsonKey of '/' works properly.

methods.name: setValueWithJsonPointerToEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Tests setting a value via JsonPointer on an empty object produces expected nested structure.

methods.name: setValueWithJsonPointerToExistingJsonObject
methods.description: Tests overwriting a value deep inside nested objects via JsonPointer.

methods.name: tryToAddAllWithNullJsonFieldsIterable
methods.description: Ensures passing null to setAll throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setAllWithEmptyJsonFieldIterableReturnsSameJsonObject
methods.description: Checks that setting an empty collection of fields returns the same object.

methods.name: setAllJsonFieldsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that adding multiple fields creates a new object containing all of them.

methods.name: tryToGetValueByNullName
methods.description: Checks that getValue(String) with null argument throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getValueWithEmptyStringReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Ensures requesting a value with empty string yields empty optional.

methods.name: tryToGetValueByNullKey
methods.description: Verifies that getValue(JsonKey) with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getExistingValueByName
methods.description: Checks retrieval of an existing value by key.

methods.name: getNonExistingValueByNameReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Ensures that non-existent key returns empty optional.

methods.name: getExistingValueByKeyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks getValue with key returns expected value.

methods.name: getValueWithPointerFromJsonObjectWithJsonArrayAtSomePointerLevel
methods.description: Tests handling of getValue with a pointer that leads to a JSON array; expects empty optional if path does not exist.

methods.name: tryToRemoveJsonFieldByNullName
methods.description: Throws NullPointerException if remove is called with null string key.

methods.name: removeNonExistingJsonFieldByNameReturnsSameJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures removal of a non-existent key returns same instance.

methods.name: removeNonExistingJsonFieldByKeyReturnsSameJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures removal with a non-existent JsonKey returns same instance.

methods.name: removingExistingJsonFieldByNameReturnsDisjunctJsonObject
methods.description: Checks that removing an existing key returns a new object without that key.

methods.name: removingSubAttributesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests removing nested attributes using JsonPointer.

methods.name: tryToRemoveJsonFieldByNullKey
methods.description: Throws NullPointerException when remove is invoked with null JsonKey.

methods.name: tryToRemoveWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Throws NullPointerException on remove with null JsonPointer.

methods.name: removeEmptyJsonPointerReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks that removing with an empty pointer yields the same object.

methods.name: removeExistingValueByPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Removes a nested value via JsonPointer and expects a properly updated object.

methods.name: getKeysReturnsExpected
methods.description: Asserts that getKeys returns all keys in insertion order.

methods.name: setExistingFieldWithJsonPointerWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests updating a nested field inside existing JSON structure via pointer.

methods.name: setAttributeByPointerToExistingJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that setting a nested attribute by pointer updates the nested object accordingly.

methods.name: tryToGetJsonObjectWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Throws NullPointerException if get(JsonPointer) is called with null.

methods.name: tryToGetJsonObjectWithEmptyJsonPointer
methods.description: Returns same object if get(JsonPointer) is called with empty pointer.

methods.name: getWithJsonPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Retrieves nested object based on a JsonPointer.

methods.name: getEmptyJsonObjectIfJsonPointerPointsAtNonExistingValue
methods.description: Ensures that path not found yields an empty object.

methods.name: tryToGetValueForNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Throws NullPointerException if getValue(JsonPointer) is called with null.

methods.name: getValueForEmptyJsonPointerReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Retrieving value with empty pointer yields optional containing the object itself.

methods.name: getExistingValueForPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getValue with a valid pointer retrieves the nested scalar value.

methods.name: getFieldWithEmptyStringReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Requesting a field with empty string returns empty optional.

methods.name: getFieldWithSlashStringReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Request for a field with slash string yields empty optional.

methods.name: getFieldWithSlashJsonKeyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a field with JsonKey '/'.

methods.name: getNestedFieldWithJsonPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Retrieves nested fields via JSON pointer string.

methods.name: tryToGetJsonObjectWithNullJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Throws NullPointerException on get with null JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: getWithEmptyJsonFieldSelectorReturnsEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Returns empty object when get with an empty JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: getWithJsonFieldSelectorReturnsExpected
methods.description: Retrieves subset object based on provided field selector.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toString() method returns the correct JSON string.

methods.name: createJsonObjectFromStringWhereFieldValueIsStringNull
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject from JSON string and verifies getValue behavior for missing/mismatched fields.

methods.name: setFieldAppendsFieldIfNoPreviousFieldWithSameKeyExists
methods.description: Adds a new field to an object; verifies size increase.

methods.name: setFieldReplacesExistingFieldWithSameKey
methods.description: Replaces existing field with same key; verifies size remains same.

methods.name: setValueViaFieldDefinitionOnEmptyObject
methods.description: Sets a value in JsonObject using JsonFieldDefinition on empty object.

methods.name: setValueViaFieldDefinitionOnNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Sets nested field value via JsonFieldDefinition on a pre-existing object.

methods.name: shouldHandleOverlappingFieldSelectors
methods.description: Checks that overlapping field selectors correctly produce expected subset object.

methods.name: emptyAndNonexistentPointersHaveNoEffectInFieldSelector
methods.description: Verifies that empty pointer selections have no effect.

methods.name: partiallyIntersectingPointersHaveNoEffectInFieldSelector
methods.description: Checks that partially overlapping pointers do not produce inconsistent subsets.

methods.name: jsonObjectsNestedInArraysShouldCompareWithoutFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Verifies that nested json objects inside arrays compare ignoring field definitions.

methods.name: validateSoftReferenceStrategy
methods.description: Validates internal caching and soft reference behavior of ImmutableJsonObject.
